description: Creates a Salesforce opportunity with the specified information. The contact ID parameter is ignored, and standard amount and probability values are sent only when positive.

account_id.description: ID of the Account this opportunity is associated with. Omitting leaves the opportunity orphaned and excluded from account-based reports.
account_id.human_parameter_description: The Salesforce Account this opportunity should be linked to. Provide the Account ID if you want to associate the deal with an existing customer; leave blank if not sure.
account_id.title: Account Id

amount.human_parameter_description: The estimated total value of the deal. Enter a number (no currency symbols) to help with pipeline forecasting.
amount.title: Amount

close_date.description: Expected close date in YYYY-MM-DD format (required field in Salesforce).
close_date.human_parameter_description: The date you expect the deal to close (YYYY-MM-DD). This helps with forecasting and scheduling follow-ups.
close_date.title: Close Date

contact_id.description: Deprecated: Salesforce Opportunity does not have a writable ContactId field. Contact-to-Opportunity associations must be managed through OpportunityContactRole. This parameter is accepted but ignored.
contact_id.human_parameter_description: Deprecated: Salesforce does not support setting ContactId directly on an Opportunity. Use OpportunityContactRole to associate contacts instead. This parameter is accepted but ignored.
contact_id.title: Contact Id

custom_fields.description: Dictionary of custom field API names and their values. Custom field names typically end with '__c' (e.g., 'Custom_Field__c'). Values are subject to org-level validation rules; invalid values raise FIELD_CUSTOM_VALIDATION_EXCEPTION.
custom_fields.human_parameter_description: Pass any custom fields defined in your Salesforce org. Use the field's API name (ending in '__c') as the key and the desired value. Example: {'Level__c': 'Primary'}
custom_fields.title: Custom Fields

examples: Large enterprise deal for cloud migration
Expanding existing contract to include new products
description.human_parameter_description: A brief summary of the opportunity. Include context or key details your team should know.
description.title: Description

lead_source.human_parameter_description: Where this opportunity came from (e.g., Web, Partner Referral). Helps track marketing and lead generation channels.
lead_source.title: Lead Source

name.human_parameter_description: The name of the deal as it should appear in Salesforce. Use something your team will immediately recognize; this is required.
name.title: Name

next_step.description: Description of next step in sales process.
next_step.human_parameter_description: What you plan to do next to move the deal forward. Add a short action note to guide follow-ups.
next_step.title: Next Step

pricebook2_id.description: ID of the price book for this opportunity.
pricebook2_id.human_parameter_description: Which price book to use for this opportunity's products and pricing. Provide the Price Book ID if your org uses multiple price books; otherwise leave blank.
pricebook2_id.title: Pricebook2 Id

probability.human_parameter_description: Your confidence level that the deal will close, as a percentage from 0 to 100. Use your best estimate to reflect deal likelihood.
probability.title: Probability

stage_name.description: Current stage of the opportunity (required field in Salesforce).
stage_name.human_parameter_description: The current sales stage for this deal (e.g., Qualification, Proposal). Choose the stage that best reflects where the deal is right now.
stage_name.title: Stage Name

type.human_parameter_description: How you’d categorize this opportunity (e.g., New Customer, Upgrade). This helps report on the type of business you’re pursuing.
type.title: Type

name: create_opportunity

errorCode.description: A standardized Salesforce error code identifying the type of error (e.g., MALFORMED_ID, FIELD_CUSTOM_VALIDATION_EXCEPTION, REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING, INVALID_FIELD).
errorCode.title: Error Code

fields.description: Array of field API names where the error occurred. Present when the error is related to specific fields, such as validation rule violations. Can be an empty array if no specific field is assigned as the error location.
fields.title: Fields

message.description: A descriptive error message explaining what went wrong with the operation.
message.title: Message

CreateOpportunityResponse.description: Response from creating an opportunity in Salesforce.

errors.description: Array of error objects. Empty array when the operation succeeds. Contains error details when the operation fails.
errors.title: Errors

id.description: The unique 18-character Salesforce ID of the newly created Opportunity record. Empty string on failure.
id.title: Id

success.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful. Returns true if the Opportunity was created successfully, false otherwise.
success.title: Success

CreateOpportunityResponse.title: CreateOpportunityResponse
